items.text: the robot's signal is clean rings now: thin arcs rise from its antenna, widen and fade, one on each beat; with reduced motion, one still arc
the flow readout says ×3, not ×3.0
the Color mixer no longer jumps when a color changes, a color animates or the scene moves on: it stays where it is and only its values change
the Color mixer as wide as the bar: the picker on the left (always open), the swatches on the right with Related and Recent each in a row, and the animation in one row along the bottom
Blend, how the lines lay onto what is drawn (normal, add, screen, multiply, overlay, difference). It comes with Pro: everyone can see it; with a key it works, and a scene keeps its blend

your own scenes always show a picture in Scenes: a frame of the stage is kept the moment you save, and until there is one, the pattern is drawn in the scene's own colors on its own ground. An empty frame kept by an older version is thrown away
your own scenes show when they were saved, small, beside the name, so an accidental save is easy to spot
every scene row has the same action places, and nothing runs under the drag grip; rename and delete for your own scenes are under ⋯ (a delete can be undone)
a scene on a light ground keeps its ground in its thumbnail

stepping between panels with ‹ › (or [ ]) keeps the panel where it is: the band stays put, the inside slides across (from the left for ‹, from the right for ›) and the panel grows or shrinks upward to fit. Only a real close slides down to its button
while a steer loop records or plays, its ∞ loops: a short dash runs round it, on the Tools button, on its tile and on the playing loop in the shelf
the Scenes list's head is one row again: All, ★ and Yours on the left, and one Sort button on the right that names the order and opens a short menu (Hand, A–Z, Most used, Newest)
Auto play is shorter. How many scenes are in play sits at the right of the top block, with its button; the panel ends with Morph. Seconds, beats and bars sit on the same row as the beads
a panel's band always sits at its bottom edge; Random no longer leaves empty space under it. Roll now is a button you can see is a button
four scene thumbnails showed another scene; all thirty-five are taken again, each checked against its name
a shared scene's link opens on that scene and stays there. Auto play, which starts by itself on a computer, used to move on to the next scene within a second; it now waits until you start it
new scene links are shorter, d.chamy.xyz/ and seven characters. Older links keep working
the mixer's master runs across the whole panel, under both columns, so it reads as the master

every delete can be undone. Deleting a beat, a formula, a scene, a word, a loop, a gesture, a typeface or a picture or video from your library shows "deleted … · Undo" at the top for 8 seconds (Cmd/Ctrl+Z works too), and it comes back exactly where it was. Missed it? Settings › Recently deleted keeps the last ten for a week
in Bytes, on a wide screen, the formula sits beside its mode, clock and view rows
the field tile's lock sits in its corner; the Tools row keeps its height
